mmek001.name: Storm Striker
mmek001.description: A well-balanced assault unit, combining agility with reliable defenses, perfect for leading rapid engagements.
mmek001.appearance: A sleek, medium-sized mech with a dynamic design that emphasizes both speed and durability. Its armor patterns are electric blue with silver accents, and it features integrated energy conduits.

mmek002.name: Titan Vanguard
mmek002.description: A heavily armored frontline warrior, built to soak up enemy fire while delivering devastating counterattacks.
mmek002.appearance: A robust and imposing mech with a bulky frame designed for maximum protection. It features reinforced armor plating in a dark gray color scheme with red highlights, and its silhouette is reminiscent of a tank.

mmek003.name: Iron Reaver
mmek003.description: A relentless brawler equipped with reinforced plating and heavy-hitting firepower.
mmek003.appearance: A rugged and aggressive mech with a design that emphasizes brute strength. It has thick armor plates in a gunmetal gray finish, accented with orange highlights. The Iron Reaver is built for close-quarters combat, featuring heavy weapon mounts and a menacing stance.

mmek004.name: Phantom Breaker
mmek004.description: A tactical disruptor, using energy-based attacks to weaken enemy defenses before striking hard.
mmek004.appearance: A sleek and agile mech with a design that emphasizes speed and precision. Its body is covered in dark gray armor with glowing blue energy conduits, and it features a distinctive hood that enhances its stealth capabilities.

mmek005.name: Thunder Sentinel
mmek005.description: A steadfast defender designed for prolonged engagements, featuring adaptive shielding and high endurance.
mmek005.appearance: A sturdy mech with a design that emphasizes durability and resilience. Its armor is a deep blue with golden accents, and it features a reinforced frame that can withstand significant damage.

mmek006.name: Ember Warden
mmek006.description: A siege specialist armed with incendiary weaponry, ideal for sustained area denial.
mmek006.appearance: A formidable mech with a design that emphasizes its role as a siege weapon. It is clad in heavy armor with a distinctive red and black color scheme, and it features powerful incendiary launchers.

mmek007.name: Shadow Bastion
mmek007.description: A versatile combat platform capable of adapting to multiple roles with advanced energy defenses.
mmek007.appearance: A mysterious mech with a design that blends stealth and power. The Shadow Bastion is covered in dark armor with subtle glowing patterns, and it features a hood that can obscure its presence.

mmek008.name: Cyclone Hunter
mmek008.description: A high-speed interceptor that excels at chasing down vulnerable targets and evading counterattacks.
mmek008.appearance: A sleek and aerodynamic mech designed for speed and agility. The Cyclone Hunter features a streamlined frame with a vibrant green and black color scheme, and it is equipped with advanced thrusters for rapid movement.

mmek009.name: Avalanche Titan
mmek009.description: A mid-weight powerhouse capable of weathering storms of firepower and striking back with force.
mmek009.appearance: A robust mech with a design that emphasizes its role as a heavy hitter. It has thick armor plates in a steel gray finish, accented with blue highlights. The Avalanche Titan is built for sustained combat, featuring powerful weapon systems and a formidable presence.

mmek010.name: Nova Lancer
mmek010.description: A cutting-edge energy-based Mek with powerful shield regeneration and precision-strike weaponry.
mmek010.appearance: An energy-based combat unit. The Nova Lancer features sleek armor with a white and blue color scheme, and it is equipped with advanced energy weapons and a high-tech energy shield system.
